items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Some of them played baseball. I know Harry James had a team and like his band.

ctx.x: Well, this fellow, Merle Turner, the singer, he played, the guy did everything. He played tennis. He swam like a fish. He was an outdoor lover. I think of musicians as being fishermen.
Some of them played baseball. I know Harry James had a team and like his band.
Well, like I said, in those days, most all the bands had some sort of outdoor activity that they would like to do. Basie's men, what about Basie?
